headline_marked: Google unveils [[Nano Banana 2 Lite]] AI image generator
headline: Google unveils Nano Banana 2 Lite AI image generator
summary: The new model generates images in 4 seconds for just $0.034 per 1,000 images, making it Google's fastest and cheapest yet.
details: Google has launched Nano Banana 2 Lite, a new AI image and video generator that promises significant speed and cost improvements over its predecessors. The company claims this latest version is its fastest and most affordable model to date.

Nano Banana 2 Lite boasts a dramatically reduced latency, capable of producing images in as little as 4 seconds. This makes it ideal for rapid image iteration and high-volume content creation, according to Google.

The cost-effectiveness of Nano Banana 2 Lite is a key selling point, priced at $0.034 per 1,000 images. This affordability aims to empower users to draft and refine content at scale without prohibitive expenses.

This release follows the original Nano Banana powered by Gemini 3.1 Flash last summer and Nano Banana 2 in February, which enhanced realism. Google also offers Nano Banana Pro for more demanding, advanced use cases.

While Nano Banana 2 is positioned as a versatile tool, Nano Banana 2 Lite is specifically optimized for high-volume, fast-paced workflows. Google often markets these models as aids for advertisement creation.

Nano Banana 2 Lite is now accessible via Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and Google’s Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. It effectively replaces the previous Nano Banana model, now considered legacy.

The company also announced a broader release of Gemini Omni Flash, a video generation model costing $0.10 per second. Additionally, Omni Product Studio was showcased, capable of transforming static images into cinematic e-commerce videos.

headline_marked: 6,000 Engineers Attend [[AI Engineer World's Fair 2026]] in San Francisco
headline: 6,000 Engineers Attend AI Engineer World's Fair 2026 in San Francisco
summary: The conference features 29 tracks, 300 speakers, and 100 expo partners, focusing on AI engineering and its applications.
details: The AI Engineer World's Fair 2026 has sold out with 6,000 attendees, featuring 29 tracks, 300 speakers, and 100 expo partners. The event is being held at Moscone West in San Francisco from June 29 to July 2.

The conference is organized by AI Engineer, a company founded by Shawn 'swyx' Wang, who also coined the term 'AI Engineer'. The event aims to bring together AI engineers, founders, and VPs of AI to discuss the latest developments in AI engineering.

The event features a diverse range of speakers, including Greg Brockman, President and co-founder of OpenAI, and Harrison Chase, CEO of LangChain. The conference focuses on technical talks and unscripted discussions, with a emphasis on real-world applications of AI.
